_about: Andrew Miller (1810-1883), Plymouth Brethren writer, from the Brethren line of Adam's Libronix inventory: Miller's Church History (Short Papers on Church History), the later Pickering & Inglis edition in three volumes, whose third volume adds W. Hoste's 'Events During the Last Fifty Years'. Volume I has no open scan on the Internet Archive (MillersChurchHistory has no text file; millerschurchhis0000andr is a 1964 reprint). Internet Archive OCR, raw; title pages read 2026-11-03. Added by lane A. No uids minted.
